text:
GENERATE BURST CS9-2_0 — Run C-9 P5, cliffside chunk 2_0, no painted neighbours yet, painted over its orthographic guide (the C-3 v4.1 grid). task_id "CS9-2_0".

IMAGE 1 is a flat-shaded ORTHOGRAPHIC GEOMETRY GUIDE: OLIVE GREEN = grassy ground on the cliff top (manuscript grass tufts, moss, small flowers, bare rock patches; NO boulders, NO props); TAN = a worn pale beaten-earth path/clearing inside the grass, the BRIGHTEST and CALMEST area (a few pebbles and faint ruts only), its edges soft, earth breaking into grass; LIGHT GREY band = the rocky verge right at the rim; GREY planes (dark grey with lighter ribs) = cliff faces dropping toward the viewer: stylised stacked manuscript rock, faceted blocks in warm ochre and grey modelled with pen hatching and a second wash, continuous all the way down to where they meet the green, slightly hazier toward their lowest part, no ledge or bottom edge drawn; BROWN planks + posts = a wooden bridge deck; MAGENTA plank = one loose bridge plank (a cracked, loose plank); PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty void.
Deliver ONE 1536x1024 painting that follows IMAGE 1 exactly: keep every boundary where it is; paint every green pixel as flat pure #00ff00; paint every other pixel as scenery.
Orthographic view: no perspective shrinking toward the top. Scale: a person standing here is 130 px tall. STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above, matched to IMAGE 2 (the approved painted style of this level: same line, hatching, washes and palette). ACCENTS: as on a manuscript page (IMAGE 3 shows how), put rich colour in small places OFF the path: clusters of wildflowers (vermilion, lapis, white, gold) in the grass and along the verge, a little verdigris moss and ochre lichen on the rock; the path itself stays calm and pale. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a painted strip was altered, a boundary moved, the green was painted over, or a join line remains — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/chunk_2_0.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS9-2_0"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the canvas to EDIT (painted strips + geometry guide)
IMAGE 2 — the approved painted STYLE of this level (Matt M1: GO / INK / ACCENTS)
IMAGE 3 — manuscript page: how rich colour sits in small places (accents only; not its layout or content)
